stem: Which of these best describes why some of the Gallaudet players lacked confidence in Cook when he first became coach of the team?

options.label: F
options.text: They thought the standards he set for the team were too high.

options.label: G
options.text: He had previously been the coach of a professional team.

options.label: H
options.text: They thought he could not understand what the world was like for the deaf.

options.label: J
options.text: He thought that winning games was more important than the players did.
